files_to_edit_help: Only add the files that need to be *edited* for the task you are working on. Viper will pull in other relevant code to provide context to the LLM.
add_web_page_to_chat: Add a web page to the chat
add_web_page_desc: Add the text content of a web page to the chat
cleared_chat_history: Cleared chat history. Now the LLM can't see anything before this line.
experimental_warning: This browser version of Viper is experimental. Please share feedback in [GitHub issues](https://github.com/matthewb2/viper/issues).
run_shell_commands_desc: Run a shell command and optionally share the output with the LLM. This is a great way to run your program or run tests and have the LLM fix bugs.
share_command_output: Share the command output with the LLM?
share_output_review: Review the output and decide whether to share
share_output_auto_fail: Automatically share the output on non-zero exit code (ie, if any tests fail)
debug_no_chunks: [debug] run_stream() did not return any displayable text chunks. The model response may be empty, or no final text was produced after streaming/tool-call handling.
debug_partial_response: [debug] Stream output was empty, but partial_response_content is available; showing it.
debug_empty_response: [debug] Final response text is empty. Check for model call failure, empty response, or a GUI streaming path issue.
